facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports, citing Angola's telecommunications ministry (MINTTICS), that Angola and Mozambique signed a bilateral memorandum in June 2026 under which Mozambique's Tmcel and TVM would use Angola's ANGOSAT-2 satellite for telecom and broadcast signals, with a commercial agreement still to be formalised.

ITWeb Africa reports that Angola's National Space Programme Management Office signed a commercial pilot agreement with Telecom Namibia to validate satellite-driven backhaul; the article gives no signing date, so the document's published date is used.

systems.owner: Angola (National Space Programme Management Office; MINTTICS announces)
systems.tiers: Tmcel and Televisao de Mocambique (Mozambique) in proof-of-concept trials; Telecom Namibia under a pilot agreement

note: Tmcel's proof-of-concept testing (announced 2026-08-25) is a trial toward a commercial agreement; the document states no service or traffic, so no service fact.
